content:
harper: Heads up — onboarding sample-job flow is flaky in private/dedicated. Node SDK's job.run is causing duplicate job executions; curl -> single job, SDK -> two runs. Anyone seen this?
leo: Can you paste the repro steps?
harper: Repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://private.api.redwood.local/v1/jobs -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"task\":\"index\",\"dataset\":\"d1\",\"idempotency_key\":\"run-42\"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 202
# body: {\"job_id\":\"j-123\",\"status\":\"queued\"}
```
harper: SDK (node):
```js
// client.jobs.run posts and then polls until complete
const resp = await client.jobs.run({ task: 'index', dataset: 'd1', idempotency_key: 'run-42' })
console.log(resp.job_id)
```
mina: What do the logs show in the private shim?
harper: From private gateway logs: POST with idempotency_key arrives once, returns 202 and j-123. SDK immediately issues GET /v1/jobs/j-123 to poll. But because SDK also retries POST internally on transient 5xx, the retry path in the SDK omits the idempotency_key header for performance reasons (bug), so the gateway treats the retry as a new create -> creates j-124. Then poll hits j-123 and returns queued, but both jobs run.
leo: So two issues: (1) SDK retry path drops idempotency_key (param drift), and (2) SDK's default behavior is to auto-retry POSTs which customers expect to be idempotent only when idempotency keys preserved. In curl, manual retry doesn't drop the key.
ops: We also saw circuit-breaker noise: SDK retries + duplicate job starts -> workers get duplicate work and bump quotas. Private clusters have stricter job dedupe and rely on idempotency key to avoid duplicates.
mina: Any auth twist here? Sometimes SDK refresh-on-401 path also retried the POST without idempotency_key while refreshing token. Combined with transient 502 that happened, this easily produced duplicates.
qa-ci: Repro in CI: set REDWOOD_ENV=private, simulate transient 502 on first POST, use expired token so refresh path triggered. Results:
```
SDK trace: POST -> 502 -> refresh_token -> POST(retry, missing idempotency_key) -> 201 new job -> GET poll -> sees both job ids
curl trace: POST -> 502 (no retry) -> user retries manually with idempotency_key -> single job
```
harper: Impact: sample-job onboarding created duplicate indexing jobs for a customer and they were billed twice. Not good.
leo: Action items: 1) Patch SDK so retry/create paths preserve idempotency_key and any caller-supplied idempotency headers (leo taking). 2) Change default SDK to NOT auto-retry non-idempotent POSTs (feature flag REDWOOD_RETRY_POSTS=false by default for private). 3) Add tests: unit test to ensure idempotency_key is included on all retry attempts, E2E that simulates 502 + token refresh. 4) Update sample-app quickstart to show how to set idempotency_key and how to call client.jobs.create(request_body={...}) if they want full control.
mina: Also add logging in SDK for when an auto-retry omits idempotency info so devs can detect at runtime.
ops: On infra side, I'll add a temporary gateway-level guard to reject retries that lack idempotency_key when original request had one (return 409 instead of creating a new job) to reduce blast radius while SDK patch rolls out.
devex-bot: Created issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/10221 (preserve idempotency across retries, disable non-idempotent POST retries by default) assigned to leo; https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/10222 (gateway guard for idempotency) assigned to ops. Canary planned tonight.
qa-ci: I'll add a CI scenario that fakes token expiry + transient 5xx and asserts SDK does not create duplicate job ids. Will add to private smoke nightly.
harper: Thanks. One more doc request: can we add a short note in onboarding that explains SDK run vs REST create+poll semantics and recommends explicit idempotency keys for job-like endpoints? Customers burned by this pattern had assumed SDK would be identical to curl.
leo: Good call. I'll include a short snippet in the quickstart and link to the PR. Will put a patch up within the day.
mina: Thanks team. I'll follow up once infra guard is live.
